{"claims":[{"claim_text":"First Amendment rights are not given to people by the government but are rights people inherently possess.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The government cannot use subsequent amendments to limit First Amendment rights.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Free Exercise Clause is both an individual and a collective liberty protecting a right to worship God according to the dictates of conscience.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for the freedom of Americans to act in accordance with their religious beliefs, not only in their houses of worship, but also in their everyday lives.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for the right of people to conduct their businesses in accordance with their religious beliefs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Condemnation of public officials who have proposed boycotts against businesses that support traditional marriage.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to protect business owners who have been subjected to hate campaigns, threats of violence, and other attempts to deny their civil rights.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for the public display of the Ten Commandments as a reflection of history and the country's Judeo-Christian heritage.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Affirmation of the rights of religious students to engage in voluntary prayer at public school events and to have equal access to school facilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Assertion of the First Amendment right of freedom of association for religious, private, service, and youth organizations to set their own membership standards.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
